- 🤖 Artificial Intelligence & AI Tools
- 📱 Latest Gadgets & Tech Innovations

snippet.title: HTML Attributes | Web Development in 60 Seconds
snippet.description:
Attributes provide additional information about an element. Learn html attributes with a quick example for beginners.

Write attributes inside the opening tag, commonly as name and value.
